mapper.update: update account set username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, password = #{password,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_active = #{isActive,jdbcType=BIT}, role_id = #{roleId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, citizen_id = #{citizenId,jdbcType=INTEGER} where account_id = #{accountId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select account_id, username, password, is_active, role_id, citizen_id from account
mapper.sql: select a.account_id, a.username, a.password, a.is_active, a.role_id, a.citizen_id, p.full_name, p.date_of_birth, p.gender, p.address, p.married, p.email, p.phone, r.role_name from account a left join profile p on a.citizen_id = p.citizen_id left join role r on a.role_id = r.role_id

where.if: and (a.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.full_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: order by a.account_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from account a left join profile p on a.citizen_id = p.citizen_id
select a.account_id, a.username, a.password, a.is_active, a.role_id, a.citizen_id from account a inner join profile p on a.citizen_id = p.citizen_id where p.email = #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: insert into account (username, password, is_active, role_id, citizen_id) values (#{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{password,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isActive,jdbcType=BIT}, #{roleId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{citizenId,jdbcType=INTEGER})
